title: Danny Jones interview throttled over a mention of mission control technology

tellings.quote: that was me mentioning about some technology at mission control

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he attracts unexplained craft, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2025 an interview he gave to another podcast host, Danny Jones, was held back from reaching viewers. Bledsoe says this happened because he mentioned some technology at mission control of NASA, the US space agency. If true, it would suggest someone did not want that detail spread.
